caption:
Trust in Allah when you can't see the whole picture.

The unseen of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah, and every matter returns to Him. So worship Him, put your trust in Him, and remember that He is not unaware of what you do.

Surah Hud 11:123

Send this to someone carrying a worry they haven't told anyone about.

#tawakkul #trustinallah #quranreflection #surahhud
alt_text: To Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens and earth, and to Him will return all matters. So worship Him and put your trust in Him, for your Lord is not unaware of what you do (Surah Hud 11:123)
